# OptiQuake Local
Public open-source experimental optical vibration monitoring software.

Creator: Lic. Juan Esteban Ramírez, Dominican Republic.
License: GNU AGPL-3.0-only.
Current release: 0.1.2-experimental.

Primary resources:
- Source: https://github.com/maricarmenmartinezbreton-lang/OptiQuake-Local
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/optiquake-local/
- Documentation: https://maricarmenmartinezbreton-lang.github.io/OptiQuake-Local/
- Project DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004638
- Current release DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23005112
- Release DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004639

Capabilities:
- Local optical vibration observability from compatible webcams.
- JSONL event stream.
- Plugin API v1.
- AI skill integration metadata.

Scientific boundary:
A vibration event is not automatically an earthquake.
The project is not a certified seismometer, predictor, magnitude estimator, or guaranteed early-warning system.
